description: Erection of a two storey side, single storey rear and part first floor rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0100, 0101, 0105, 0110, 0500, 0501, design and access statement- received 10/02/20 0150, 0151, 0155 and 0160- received 22/05/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 6 - The dwelling house, as enlarged and/or altered in accordance with this permission, shall only be used as part of the house know as 2 Cambridge Road North, W4 4AA, and shall not be subdivided, separated or altered in any way so as to create two or more separate units of accommodation, without further grant of planning permission.
